nis_domain.description: The NIS domain name; must match across all NIS servers and clients in the domain.

nis_server.description: Whether this host acts as an NIS server (serves maps to clients).

nis_client.description: Whether this host acts as an NIS client (performs NIS lookups). Usually enabled if NIS is in use.

nis_servers.description: List of NIS server hostnames or IPs. Clients use them in order; fallback via colon-separated list.

items.description: Hostname or IP address of an NIS server.

ypserv_opts.description: Command-line options passed to the ypserv daemon (e.g., "-p 1053").

yppasswdd_opts.description: Command-line options passed to the yppasswdd daemon (e.g., "-s domain").

rpcbind_opts.description: Options for the rpcbind service (e.g., "-w"). Only needed if rpcbind is started separately.

nisplus_enabled.description: Enable NIS+ compatibility (not recommended for modern deployments; NIS+ is obsolete).

nis_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for NIS map lookups before retrying or failing.

nis_retries.description: Number of times to retry NIS lookups before giving up.
